dedupe_keys.name: trust hpc thermohydraulic platform and triocfd cea

description: TRUST is a high performance computing thermohydraulic engine for computational fluid dynamics developed at the Department of System and Structure Modelling (DM2S) of the French Atomic Energy Commission, CEA. The site read on 2026-09-26 says TRUST began with conduction, incompressible single-phase and low Mach number flows with a weakly compressible multi-species solver, now simulates compressible multi-phase flows, and is being ported to GPUs with the Kokkos library as a demonstrator of the CExA project. TRUST is the kernel of several CEA application codes; TrioCFD is the open source one, focused on turbulence modelling. Coverage is general thermohydraulics, not a plant or country. The platform and TrioCFD are published under a BSD licence on GitLab at no cost, and TRUST relies on SALOME, MEDCoupling, ICoCo and VisIt. Caveats: it is an HPC code aimed at CFD specialists, and plant models are not supplied. Simulation uses are reactor thermohydraulics and turbulence studies for safety analysis of nuclear plant components, and a CFD core for digital twin work. Related records: platform-salome-numerical-simulation is the pre and post processing platform TRUST relies on, and platform-code-saturne-cfd is EDF's CFD solver.
